description: Unit test script for update_webgl_conformance_tests, including test cases for HTML header stripping and include rewriting.

classes.name: TestTranslation
classes.description: Unit test class for testing webgl translation functions, including header stripping and include rewriting.

methods.name: assert_unchanged
methods.description: Asserts that the translation of the given text remains unchanged.

methods.name: assert_translate
methods.description: Asserts that the translation of the input text matches the expected output.

methods.name: test_simple_unchanged
methods.description: Tests that simple HTML snippets are unchanged after translation.

methods.name: test_header_strip
methods.description: Tests that HTML comments used as headers are correctly stripped during translation.

methods.name: dont_strip_other_headers
methods.description: Ensures that comments not matching header patterns are not removed.

methods.name: test_include_rewriting
methods.description: Tests that resource include paths are correctly rewritten or left unchanged.
